name: Flexi-wage Subsidy
description: An employment assistance product that provides wage subsidies to employers to support clients facing barriers to employment, with payment structured across bands based on disadvantage level and risk.

attributes.summary: A wage subsidy product for clients facing barriers to employment, structured across payment bands with criteria covering client disadvantage, job eligibility, and employer solvency, including extra training and in-work support assistance.
attributes.eligibility: Client eligibility: disadvantaged in labour market, significant barriers to employment, low job security or underemployed, displaced due to economic downturn, at risk of long-term benefit receipt, specific employment needs, 65 years or over. Job eligibility: entry level requirements of a job. Employer eligibility: solvency, not inappropriate businesses.
attributes.payment_details: Payment structured across three bands (Band 1, Band 2, Band 3) based on client's level of disadvantage and risk.
